title: Benefit Application Document Extraction

the words before and after, which carry the layout

label: For "Benefit Application Document Extraction": Extract fields from payslips, bank statements, leases and IDs submitted with benefit applications so caseworkers review structured data rather than retyping. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Auto-fill with no confirmation.
